Visitors can also follow a new trail to witness archaeological work in action, and explore more routes with breathtaking views throughout the region.

author: National Geographic
description:
Outside the bright city lights of Abu Dhabi is a peaceful, life-sustaining ecosystem. Join National Geographic photographer Nichole Sobecki as she explores Jubail Mangrove Park, one of the rare places on Earth where mangrove populations are actively expanding, not shrinking, and available to experience through walking or kayaking. Along with Marawah Marine Biosphere Reserve, home of the second-largest population of dugongs in the world, these spots showcase the incredible, photogenic nature of Abu Dhabi. | From the known to the unknown, discover Abu Dhabi at your own pace: @VisitAbuDhabiChannel

#AbuDhabi #Dubai #Explore

author: National Geographic
description:
What are the world's worst natural disasters? In this MEGA episode from National Geographic, delve into the meteorological forces that create hurricanes, snowstorms, wildfires, and mudslides, and the devastation these natural disasters leave in their wakes. In two episodes of Storm Rising, Reed Timmer and Mike Reiss collect data during record-breaking chaos of extreme weather events. In an episode of Witness to Disaster, first hand footage and interviews breaks down the devastating mudslide that forever changed the quiet California town of Montecito. 

Featuring three, full episodes:

Storm Rising - Hurricane Double Threat - 00:00 
Amid a record-breaking hurricane season, Reed and Mike race to collect data from inside back-to-back hurricanes projected to make landfall.

Storm Rising - Overnight Disaster - 44:02 
Wildfires and a snowstorm create chaos of extreme weather events as Reed and Mike race to collect data inside Hurricane Sally.

Witness to Disaster - California Mudslide - 1:2
title: Investigating Extreme Natural Disasters | MEGA EPISODE SPECIAL | National Geographic
